source.paraphrase: Vue supports both Options API and Composition API. Either style can cover common use cases.

invariants.why: An Options API component is supported and may be appropriate; its syntax does not establish a defect.
invariants.fixHint: Choose the component style that fits the project; migrate only when the team adopts that convention.
invariants.avoid: Adding a setup key does not make an Options component invalid. This blanket style check remains off.

source.paraphrase: Props flow one way down. A child assigns to its own copy or emits; it never writes the prop.

invariants.why: A child that writes a prop fights the parent on the next render, and the value snaps back without warning.
invariants.fixHint: Emit an update event such as update:title and let the parent change the value. Keep a local copy in a ref when the child needs to edit.
invariants.avoid: Reading props is fine. The rule only fires on writes: assignment and augmented assignment to props, dot or bracket.

source.paraphrase: Composition functions run with no instance. this is undefined there; state arrives through arguments.

invariants.why: A composable that reads this only works when something binds an instance, so it breaks the moment it is reused elsewhere.
invariants.fixHint: Take state as an argument or close over a module-level reactive object. Composables receive everything through parameters.
invariants.avoid: A bare this as a value (const self = this) is the same instance grab. Bracket access this["x"] is also covered.

source.locator: A New Global API: createApp; 2.x Global API table
source.paraphrase: Vue 3 has no Vue constructor. Vue.config, component, directive, mixin, use and prototype move to the app from createApp; Vue.extend is removed.

invariants.why: On Vue 3 these calls fail at runtime or register nothing, so plugins, components and config silently never reach the app.
invariants.fixHint: Create the app with createApp(App) and call app.use, app.component, app.directive and app.config on it. Put shared globals on app.config.globalProperties; type components with defineComponent.
invariants.avoid: Vue.extend is not a typing helper on Vue 3; use defineComponent. The CDN global build's Vue.createApp, Vue.ref and Vue.nextTick are valid and are not matched. A Vue 2.7 project can turn this rule off.

source.paraphrase: Use template refs (useTemplateRef or ref) to obtain direct references to DOM elements owned by a component after mount instead of querying the global document.

invariants.why: Global document queries fail during SSR, match elements from sibling component instances, and run before Vue mounts the template when called during setup.
invariants.fixHint: Bind a ref attribute in the template and read it with useTemplateRef('name') or ref(null) inside onMounted.
invariants.avoid: Direct calls on document, window.document, and globalThis.document for getElementById, querySelector, querySelectorAll, getElementsByClassName, and getElementsByTagName are matched. Queries on local Element or XMLDocument receivers pass. The call is matched when the file imports vue, a vue- or @vue/ package, nuxt, #imports or a .vue file, or when the call is inside a function. A query at the top level of a script with no such import is not matched. A function in a file that has no Vue code is still matched.
